_comment: The suite needs fastapi/chromadb/pytest-asyncio, which live in ./venv (see README: `pytest tests/ -v` from the venv). The system python3 has none of them, so a bare `python3 -m pytest` fails at import on tests/test_api.py and tests/test_chat.py and takes the whole run down — tests/ has an __init__.py, so a collection error is fatal, not a skip. Point every rule at the venv interpreter and run the whole suite: it takes ~3s, and the modules are coupled enough (repos.yml drives kb_indexer, kb_coverage and the API) that a partial run proves little.

rules.run: ./venv/bin/python -c "import sys,yaml;[yaml.safe_load(open(f)) for f in sys.argv[1:]] and print('yaml ok')" {file} && ./venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_manifest.py
